    List.take m l

    = Role.follower → uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ ownLogGhost γ id
    s' none W

    id q E)

theorem ownLogGhost_campaign [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : s.role ≠ Role.leader → uint.Z s.term + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ
    id s kl W -∗ ∃ F, ⌜W.camps !! (s.term + W64 1) = none⌝ ∗ ownLogGhost γ id (pbecomeCandidate id
    s) none (virt W [Prom.camp (s.term + W64 1) F s.commit, Prom.vote (s.term + W64 1) id false F])
    ∗ promJust γ id W (Prom.camp (s.term + W64 1) F s.commit) ∗ logRecs γ base0 F ∗ ⌜PlogWf base0 F
    ∧ plogLast base0 F = plogLast s.base s.log⌝ ∗ ([∗map] k ↦ _u ∈ W.acks, iprop(∀ x, hist γ F k.fst
    k.snd (vbnd (s.term + W64 1) false))) ∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ F = fp ++ s.log⌝ ∗ logRecs γ
    base0 fp ∗ commitIn γ F s.commit s.term

    γ t X ∗ ⌜(plogTermAt base0 X i).isSome = true ∧ plogTermAt base0 X i = plogTermAt base0 (fp ++
    es) i⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_mono' [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (kl
    kl' : Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : s'.log = s.log → s'.base = s.base → (s'.role = Role.leader →
    s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader →
    uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term
    = s.term ∧ s'.commit = s.commit) → uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z
    s'.commit → KlStep s s' kl kl' → s'.commit = s.commit ∨ uint.Z s'.commit ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base
    s.log → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ (□ ∀ fp, matchedOk γ id s fp -∗ matchedOk γ id s' fp) -∗ (∀
    fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log)
    s.commit s.term -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s'.commit s'.term) -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧
    PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s) -∗ isCommitted γ
    (cprefix fp s')) -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s' kl' W

    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) (i : w64) (Hnc : s.role ≠ Role.candidate) (Hli : s.role = Role.leader
    → uint.Z i ≤ plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log) : ⊢ ackOk γ s (s.term, i) -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp
    ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ hist

    (Prom.ack s.term i)) ∗ promJust γ id W (Prom.ack s.term i) ∗ □ (durFrags γ id (W.add (Prom.ack
    s.term i)) -∗ isAcked γ id s.term i)

theorem hist_replace [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F F' Y : List EntryM) (t i T : w64)
    (B B' c : Int) (k L : w64) : B ≤ B' → uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z T → uint.Z T < B' → 0 < uint.Z k → c ≤
    uint.Z k ∧ uint.Z k ≤ uint.Z L → (∀ (j : w64), uint.Z j < c → plogTermAt base0 F' j = plogTermAt
    base0 F j) → (∀ (j : w64), c ≤ uint.Z j ∧ uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z L → plogTermAt base0 F' j =
    plogTermAt base0 Y j ∧ (plogTermAt base0 Y j).isSome = true) → plogTermAt base0 F k ≠ plogTermAt
    base0 Y k → (∀ (j : w64), uint.Z L < uint.Z j → plogTermAt base0 F' j = none) → ⊢ leadFull γ T Y
    -∗ hist γ F t i B -∗ hist γ F' t i B'

    w64) : ⊢ ghostMapAuth γa 1 acks -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ u ∈ acks, k ↪[γa]□ u) ==∗ ghostMapAuth γa 1 <[k
    := ()]>acks ∗ ([∗map] k ↦ u ∈ <[k := ()]>acks, k ↪[γa]□ u) ∗ k ↪[γa]□ ()

theorem ownLogGhost_mono [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : s'.log = s.log → s'.base = s.base → s'.commit = s.commit → (s'.role
    = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ s'.matched = s.matched) → (s'.role =
    Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term = s.term) → (s.role = Role.leader → s'.role =
    Role.leader) → s'.term = s.term → (s'.vote = W64 0 → s.vote = W64 0) → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W
    -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s' kl W

    PState) : FullOk s.base fp1 → FullOk s.base fp2 → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 fp1 -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp2
    -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp1 s) -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp2 s)

theorem acksOk_upd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (s s' : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 ×
    w64) Unit) : uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader →
    uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z s'.commit → AcksTerm s acks → ⊢ □
    (⌜s'.term = s.term⌝ -∗ ∀ i, ⌜uint.Z s'.commit < uint.Z i⌝ -∗ ackAgree γ s.base s.log s.term i -∗
    ackAgree γ s'.base s'.log s.term i) -∗ acksOk γ s acks -∗ acksOk γ s' acks

theorem replOk_message [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg)
    (fp : List EntryM) : PlogWfR s.base s.log → ReplOk id s m → id ≠ W64 0 → (γ.reDyn ≠ none → m.ty
    = MsgType.app → ConfI1 (fp ++ s.log) (uint.Z m.commit).toNat) → (m.ty = MsgType.snap → ∀ (T :
    GSet w64), γ.reTracked = some T → id ∈ T ∧ m.dst ∈ T) → ⊢ isLeader γ id s.term -∗ leadPrefix γ
    id s.term s.base s.log -∗ lpfull γ id s.term s.base s.log fp -∗ logRecs γ s.base s.log -∗
    commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ baseOk γ s.base -∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp s) -∗
    isMessage γ m

theorem ownLogGhost_ack_agree [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s :
    PState) (kl : Option w64) (γs : SlotNames) (V : DurMaps) (πc : List Prom) (i : w64) : γ.reSlot
    !! id = some γs → ↑(slotN γ id) ⊆ E → ⊢ slotInv γ id -∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V -∗
    ownLogGhost γ id s kl (virt V πc) -∗ isAcked γ id s.term i ={E}=∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V
    ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl (virt V πc) ∗ ∀ x, ackAgree γ s.base s.log s.term i

    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ ⌜↑γ.reBoot.length ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧
    (γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 1 ≤ uint.Z s.term)⌝ ∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ γ.reBoot <+: fp ++ s.log⌝ ∗
    logRecs γ base0 fp

    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ raftCommitInv γ

theorem ownLogGhost_upd [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s s' : PState) (kl kl'
    : Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : (s'.role = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧
    s'.base = s.base ∧ s'.log = s.log) → (s'.role ≠ Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader → uint.Z
    s.term < uint.Z s'.term) → (s'.role = Role.candidate → s.role = Role.candidate ∧ s'.term =
    s.term ∧ s'.commit = s.commit) → uint.Z s.term ≤ uint.Z s'.term → uint.Z s.commit ≤ uint.Z
    s'.commit → KlStep s s' kl kl' → LogOk s' → ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ □ (⌜s'.term = s.term⌝
    -∗ ∀ i, ⌜uint.Z s'.commit < uint.Z i⌝ -∗ ackAgree γ s.base s.log s.term i -∗ ackAgree γ s'.base
    s'.log s.term i) -∗ logRecs γ s'.base s'.log -∗ (□ ∀ fp, matchedOk γ id s fp -∗ matchedOk γ id
    s' fp) -∗ baseOk γ s'.base -∗ (∀ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp ∧ PlogWf s.base s.log ∧ TermsLe s (fp ++
    s.log)⌝ -∗ logRecs γ base0 fp -∗ commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term -∗ isCommitted γ
    (cprefix fp s) -∗ ∃ fp', ⌜(FullOk s'.base fp' ∧ PlogWf s'.base s'.log ∧ TermsLe s' (fp' ++
    s'.log)) ∧ (s'.role ≠ Role.follower → fp' ++ s'.log = fp ++ s.log)⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 fp' ∗
    commitIn γ (fp' ++ s'.log) s'.commit s'.term ∗ isCommitted γ (cprefix fp' s') ∗ □ ∀ t i, ⌜uint.Z
    t ≤ uint.Z s.term⌝ -∗ hist γ (fp ++ s.log) t i (bnd s kl) -∗ hist γ (fp' ++ s'.log) t i (bnd s'
    kl')) -∗ ownLogGhost γ id s' kl' W

theorem ownLogGhost_lead_full [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl
    : Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : s.role = Role.leader → ⊢ isLeader γ id s.term -∗ ownLogGhost γ id
    s kl W -∗ (∃ fp, leadPrefix γ id s.term s.base s.log ∗ lpfull γ id s.term s.base s.log fp ∗
    commitIn γ (fp ++ s.log) s.commit s.term) ∗ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W

theorem AcksTerm_insert (s : PState) (acks : GMap (w64 × w64) Unit) (t i : w64) : uint.Z t ≤ uint.Z
    s.term → AcksTerm s acks → AcksTerm s <[(t, i) := ()]>acks

theorem vote_excl [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (γs
    : SlotNames) (V : DurMaps) (πc : List Prom) (ldr : w64) (q : GSet w64) : γ.reSlot !! id = some
    γs → ↑(slotN γ id) ⊆ E → VoteHistOk (virt V πc).voted s → ⊢ slotInv γ id -∗ ghostVar γs.fst
    (Qp.half 1) V -∗ isWin γ ldr s.term q ={E}=∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V ∗ ⌜s.vote = W64 0 →
    ¬id ∈ q⌝

theorem boot_term_le [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (F : List EntryM) (T : w64) : PlogWf
    base0 F → γ.reBoot <+: F → (∀ (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 F j = some x → uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z T)
    → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 F -∗ ⌜γ.reBoot ≠ [] → 1 ≤ uint.Z T⌝

theorem ownLogGhost_matched [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ ∃ fp, ⌜FullOk s.base fp⌝ ∗ logRecs γ
    base0 fp ∗ matchedOk γ id s fp

theorem slot_campK [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (Em : CoPset) (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (γs :
    SlotNames) (V : DurMaps) (πc : List Prom) (T : w64) (F : List EntryM) (k : w64) : γ.reSlot !! id
    = some γs → ↑(slotN γ id) ⊆ Em → PromsFresh V πc → ⊢ slotInv γ id -∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1)
    V -∗ isCampK γ id T F k ={Em}=∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V ∗ ⌜(virt V πc).camps !! T = some
    (F, k) ∧ ∀ (F' : List EntryM) (k' : w64), ¬Prom.camp T F' k' ∈ πc⌝

theorem slot_open [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (Em : CoPset) (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (γs :
    SlotNames) (V : DurMaps) : γ.reSlot !! id = some γs → ↑(slotN γ id) ⊆ Em → ⊢ slotInv γ id -∗
    ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V ={Em,Em \ ↑(slotN γ id)}=∗ ∃ E, ⌜DurLe E V⌝ ∗ durShares γ id
    (Qp.half 1) E ∗ ghostVar γs.fst (Qp.half 1) V ∗ (durShares γ id (Qp.half 1) E ={Em \ ↑(slotN γ
    id),Em}=∗ True)

def KlStep (s s' : PState) (kl kl' : Option w64) : Prop :=
  kl' = kl ∧ s'.term = s.term ∧ (s'.vote = W64 0 → s.vote = W64 0) ∧ (s'.role = Role.leader → s.role = Role.leader) ∨
    kl' = none ∧ uint.Z s.term < uint.Z s'.term ∧ s'.role ≠ Role.leader

theorem ownLogGhost_acks_ok [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (s : PState) (kl :
    Option w64) (W : DurMaps) : ⊢ ownLogGhost γ id s kl W -∗ acksOk γ s W.acks

def DurMaps_inhabited : Inhabited DurMaps :=
  { default := DurMaps.empty }
